body:
Shoebill Stork CR 1/2

This stork-legged bird has a wide, shoe-shaped bill. It stands stock-still watching for prey.

XP 400
N Medium animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 7 (1d8+2)
Fort +4, Ref +4, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 40 ft. (average)
Melee bite +3 (1d6+3)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 5
Base Attack +0; CMB +3; CMD 15
Feats Stealthy
Skills Perception +4, Stealth +4

ECOLOGY

Environment tropical swamps
Organization solitary
Treasure none

Shoebill storks are wading hunters that reside in swamps. They are slow-moving hunters to the point that they are described as ‘statue-like’. Their bills are wide as compared to other storks and give them their name ‘shoebill’.
